result.finding: Oracle Database Free (23ai) is the sole external service dependency, used for both relational data storage and binary photo data (BLOB). The automated script did not detect it as it targets PostgreSQL/MySQL/Redis/RabbitMQ patterns.
evidence: docker-compose.yml: oracle-db service using image gvenzl/oracle-free:latest (Oracle Database Free 23ai)
pom.xml: ojdbc8 runtime dependency (Oracle JDBC driver)
Photos stored as BLOB in Oracle DB (no file system or object storage used)
No Redis, RabbitMQ, Kafka, Elasticsearch, or other external services
values: Connection: JDBC thin driver on port 1521
Usage: relational data + BLOB photo storage
